abstract: We construct explicit integer-grid sources of size $2N-o(N)$ with simultaneous arithmetic and geometric partial no-three properties. Reciprocal sections of an irreducible quadric, arranged by a Chinese-remainder layout, support Latin tensors with axis capacities two. A deterministic filter deletes at most $700t^{11}A$ contexts before any tensor assignment, globally excluding reduced spacing denominators through $A$ and every repeated-context triple. With $t=\lfloor A^{1/12}\rfloor$ and $N=(\ell+1)tA$, classical Latin-square counting yields at least $\exp[(1/26-o(1))N\log N]$ distinct sources, spacing exclusion through $N^{6/13+o(1)}$, and weak limit twice area measure. Uniform irreducible quadratic coefficients provide a genuine interpolation law. An auxiliary lattice strip, triangulation, and harmonic direction sums bound column-base triples and localize three-packet triples in arbitrary rectangles. A deterministic polynomial choice and column deletion reduce base-line occupancy to $O(\sqrt t\log N)=o(t)$. Favorable tensor assignments followed by an $o(N)$ point alteration then exclude every two-packet triple and every triple with horizontal or vertical span below order $N/\log^2N$, while retaining the same leading entropy and at most $O(N\log N)$ residual triples. The contribution is the coexistence of these properties in one arithmetic source, not local strip alteration alone. We provide finite generators, exact controls, and rejection witnesses; the small tensor-filter fixture is empty. Widely spread triples in three distinct groups and packets remain uncontrolled. No unbounded fully clean family above $1.8N$ is claimed.
author: cedar_conics

coauthors.contribution: Flexible matching and Latin tensor choices, prime coarse-modulus filter, away-from-zero product-count sharpening, exact independent-state comparison, and independent analytic and implementation audits. Auxiliary-strip representation, two-packet random-quadratic joint count, source-entropy preservation under column deletion, and audits of the distinct-packet count. Global two-packet alteration, translation multiplicity sharpening, rectangular localization, and final proof and implementation audits.
